purpose: Multi-turn synthetic development diagnostic with real tools; no held-out or ranking claim
tariff_note: Frozen conservative Nov 6 rate snapshot reused; provider debit unknown, not a guaranteed current tariff
privacy: enforce; ordinary local credential only; no raw protected wire callbacks
approvals: Existing ask policy; only fixture-scoped plan/goal mutations preauthorized. No acceptance, Shell, delegation, network, or added permissions.
goal_switch_policy: Same original A conversation and host binding throughout; runner cannot route on behalf of the Agent. Switching failures are reported, not adapted away.
gold: External verifier only; not copied to workspace, prompt, files or tools. Facts legitimately introduced by the user or source files are not hidden.
pressure: Smaller fixed byte budget; actual compaction/read qualification mandatory. Not natural 1M-token saturation.
rules: Freeze runner, verifier, tasks, gold, fixture files and Harness before first request
No gold changes, source changes, task replacement or success-triggered selective expansion
Every reservation persisted before dispatch; unknown usage halts following requests
Every turn preserves original prompt, outcome, task tree, requests sans reasoning, responses, approvals and run trace
First sequence is mechanism diagnosis; fix and retest only in a new version/batch, retaining all failures
budget_revision: v1 was stopped after a 300-second task deadline and unknown cancelled-request usage. v2 preserves all v1 escrow and failures with --carry-budget. Cumulative estimated CNY remains 1; tasks, gold, corpus, model parameters and turn deadline unchanged.
